title: Per-route coldstart + prewarm telemetry curated mart
creator: Aisha N'Diaye
description: Create a curated, queryable mart that captures cold-start events, prewarm attempts, and subsequent invocation characteristics at the per-route level. The goal is to enable fast SLO debugging (root-causing cold starts), evaluate prewarm effectiveness, and produce daily KPIs for the Console SLO/cost dashboard. This mart will replace ad-hoc joins across raw-event topics and provide a single source of truth for coldstart-related analysis.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical table (console.prewarm_coldstart_events_v1) exists in the warehouse with documented schema and examples
Ingest pipeline populates table with >99% of cold-start events within SLA (15 minutes) for backfill and <2 minute latency for nearline streaming writes
Row-level deduplication logic prevents double-counting from multiple telemetry sources
Query patterns for SLO drilldowns (by tenant, route, model_variant, region, time window) run within target P95 < 1s for common slices
Automated daily tests validate prewarm effectiveness metrics compared to baseline
schema_overview: Primary grain: coldstart_event_id (UUID) representing a unique cold-start occurrence
Key columns: event_date (date), route_id (string), workspace_id (string), model_variant (string), instance_pool_id (string), region (string)
Telemetry fields: startup_duration_ms, kv_cache_warmed (boolean), prewarm_triggered (boolean), prewarm_method (enum: proactive|reactive|none), prewarm_latency_ms
Storage & partitioning: partitioned by event_date, clustered by route_id, model_variant; retention TTL = 365 days
transform_notes: Source events: route_start, instance_heartbeat, prewarm_request, invocation_start from console-ingest topic and dedupe using event_uuid + ingestion_source
Normalization: unify timestamp formats, map legacy route_id aliases to canonical route_id via lookup table (console.route_registry_v2)
Coldstart detection: require instance_heartbeat absent within preceding 5 minutes AND startup_duration_ms > 50ms threshold; mark is_true_coldstart accordingly
Prewarm effectiveness: join prewarm_request -> subsequent_invocation_start within 10 minutes to measure success and compute prewarm_latency_ms
Backfill strategy: run nightly Spark job that reconstructs 90 days of coldstart events from raw event lake for initial population
testing_plan: Unit tests for dedupe UDFs and coldstart detection heuristics
Integration tests: synthetic pipeline that injects labelled coldstart and prewarm events and asserts downstream mart rows
Performance tests: benchmark typical aggregation queries over 30 days of data to ensure P95 < 2s on staging cluster
Canary checks: run a daily data quality job that compares mart counts to raw source counts and alerts >5% delta
Data regression: add SQL assertions to CI that check schema compatibility and nullability expectations
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (week 1): deploy schema and streaming ETL to staging; validate with synthetic traffic
Stage 2 (week 2): enable nearline writes to prod (no downstream consumers) and run backfill for last 90 days
Stage 3 (week 3): flip read-only dashboards to use mart for selected SLO dashboards and cohort analyses; monitor latency/cost
Stage 4 (week 4): full cutover for Console Prewarm reports and expose table to internal analysts with access controls
Fallback: maintain nightly snapshot of pre-cutover mart for 7 days; revert dashboards to snapshot if P95 query latency regresses
query_examples: Top 10 routes by coldstart rate over last 7 days (group by route_id, region, model_variant)
Prewarm hit-rate by route and prewarm_method for last 30 days
Correlation of startup_duration_ms to first_invocation_latency_ms bucketed by instance_pool_id
Tenant-level daily coldstart_count and cost_estimate (join to per-token cost model)
perf_targets: Nearline ETL lag: < 2 minutes for streaming writes
Backfill throughput: 500M raw events / 24h window using Spark cluster sizing guide
Common slice query P95: < 1s, P99: < 3s (on optimized materialized views)
access_control: Table created in analytics namespace with grant to data-analysts and ConsoleOps roles
Sensitive columns (workspace_id) masked for external vendor read-only roles
Audit log enabled for CREATE/ALTER/GRANT actions on the mart
